name: Drawers
author: Christian Haynes
description: Group bar widgets into expandable drawers, with an Auto-Drawer wizard that proposes a layout from the widgets already on your bar.

barWidget.description: An expandable drawer that hosts other bar widgets live in a dropdown, with a staged manager and an auto-arrange wizard.

schema.label: Icon
schema.description: Nerd font glyph or icon character on the bar.

schema.label: Label
schema.description: Optional text label displayed beside the icon.

schema.label: Show Label
schema.description: Whether to display the text label on the bar.

schema.label: Tooltip
schema.description: Custom tooltip on bar hover (defaults to auto-generated count).

schema.label: Dropdown Layout
schema.description: Single-row pill bar or compact multi-column grid card.

schema.label: Grid Columns
schema.description: Number of columns when in grid layout.

schema.label: Alert Notification Mode
schema.description: How alerts are surfaced: satellite icon slide-out, badge dot on drawer, or off.

schema.label: Alert Slide-out Duration (seconds)
schema.description: How long an alerted widget stays slid out on the bar before folding back.
